prompt_fragment: This asset is a top-down hex tile. Compose it for clear map readability, with the terrain filling the frame evenly and no horizon line.
raw_description:
Orthographic top-down view of a cold-water reef — dense kelp-black and
rust tones over deep blue water, skeletal coral structures, pale stone
glimpsed between. Dense and slightly forbidding.

formatted_prompt.scene: Ink and watercolor hex tile, orthographic top-down view of a cold-water reef, dense skeletal coral and kelp mats over deep blue-slate water, ember rust and pale vellum stone glimpsed between dark fronds.

subjects.description: Dense top-down kelp canopy, tangled dark fronds layered over skeletal branching coral structures, matte and forbidding, filling the hex frame evenly
Pale fractured coral branches and exposed stone fragments visible between kelp, thin nib-pen linework, cold and angular
Cold deep water pooling between structures, dense gravitational shadow pressing up between reef formations
